q: What is the smallest braid, in terms of both strand count n and crossing number |b|, at which the DQC1 Hadamard test for the Fibonacci-representation trace gives a rigorous quantum speedup over a plain classical Fibonacci-representation matrix product?
basis: We ran only B_2 (representation dimension 3), for which the classical cost of forming the 3x3 matrix product and its trace is O(1). The paper's polynomial-time DQC1 guarantee is asymptotic and does not identify the practical n,|b| crossover, so where DQC1 first beats direct classical simulation is left unquantified by our small-instance run.
next_steps: Instrument replicate_shor_jordan.py to sweep n=2..10 and |b|=1..50 for random braid words in B_n; time both the direct dense matrix product cost (O(dim^3 * |b|) with dim = f_{n+1}) and a classical simulator of the DQC1 circuit; identify the smallest (n,|b|) for which DQC1 asymptotics (poly(n,|b|)) beat the classical dim^3 exponent.

q: Is Shor-Jordan Eq. (11) still exact at the other primitive 10th roots of unity A = e^{-i(2k+1)*pi/5} (k=0..4), and does the associated Fibonacci path-model representation itself change basis in a way that preserves or breaks DQC1-completeness?
basis: SJ tie the whole construction to A=e^{-i3pi/5}. We only verified this single choice. Since D=-A^2-A^{-2} is invariant under A -> A^{-1} and equals phi for all such A, the numeric prefactor changes but the representation might not; the reduction's completeness at other roots was not tested here.
next_steps: Rerun replicate_shor_jordan.py with A in {e^{-i pi/5}, e^{-i 3pi/5}, e^{-i 7pi/5}, e^{-i 9pi/5}} for the same trefoil braid; compare each result against V_{3_1}(t=A^-4); document which choices preserve exact reproduction and which merely give conjugate/rescaled values.

q: Why does our Qiskit shot-based DQC1 estimate at N=24000 shots exhibit a ~4x error asymmetry between the right trefoil (|Delta|=1.8e-2) and the left trefoil (|Delta|=4.7e-3), when the two should differ only by complex conjugation and thus have identical sampling variance?
basis: Observed directly in report/evidence/dqc1_shots_results.json. Same shot count, same circuit topology, only sign of the writhe (and hence the Im-part sign) changes. A 4x error gap is well outside single-run RNG jitter for 24000 shots.
next_steps: Repeat both runs across 30 random seeds, log per-seed Re and Im errors; test whether the asymmetry is (a) seed-driven, (b) driven by the S^dagger convention in the Im circuit, or (c) an aliasing between the S^dagger and the sign of Im(V) that shows up only when Im(V) has one particular sign; if (b) or (c), add a systematic sign check to the shot-based estimator.

q: The Shor-Jordan reduction feeds a Fibonacci-weighted Markov trace into the DQC1 machine, but the DQC1 Hadamard test natively measures the uniform matrix trace Tr(U)/2^n. Is there a resource-efficient Qiskit primitive to prepare the SJ weighted mixed state on n>2 target qubits, and how does its state-preparation depth scale with n?
basis: We sidestepped this by computing the Fibonacci-weighted trace classically for the small B_2 example. SJ's Sec. 5 details how the mixed-state preparation goes, but our replication did not implement that piece in a scalable Qiskit form, so the constant factors of a genuinely scalable Qiskit DQC1-Jones pipeline remain empirically unknown.
next_steps: Implement the SJ Fibonacci-weighted mixed-state prep as a Qiskit initial density matrix, benchmark its preparation cost (2-qubit gate count and depth) as a function of n for n=2..8, and validate that the Hadamard test on that mixed state converges to the weighted trace rather than the uniform one.

q: How does the SJ Jones-polynomial signal-to-noise ratio degrade under realistic DQC1 noise models (depolarised control-qubit polarisation eps << 1, plus 2-qubit gate errors ~1e-3), and at what braid crossing number does the signal fall below detectability for a fixed shot budget?
basis: Our simulation used an ideal DQC1 model (eps=1 for the clean qubit, no gate noise). Real NMR/photonic DQC1 implementations report clean-qubit polarisations of 1e-4 to 1e-2. SJ cite this experimental context as motivation but do not analyze noise-scaling of the reduction, so the practical reach of the algorithm on near-term devices is undetermined.
next_steps: Add a Qiskit-Aer noise model (depolarising channel on all target qubits after each controlled-V slice, plus a partial-polarisation prep of the control) to dqc1_qiskit_shots.py; sweep polarisation eps over {1, 1e-1, 1e-2, 1e-3} and gate error over {0, 1e-3, 1e-2}, plot the reconstruction error vs braid length |b| for a family of B_3 braids, and identify the noise regime beyond which the reduction fails.
